comparison.objective: Index a wafer while preventing probes from scratching it.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually hold a spring-return probe assembly raised while moving a wafer stage, then restore contact.
comparison.success_condition: Wafer reaches the next position with no cumulative lateral probe contact; probes must be returned and handles released. Exact geometric thresholds are not supplied in the body.
comparison.reason: This is coordinated lift-and-index manipulation with irreversible scratch avoidance, not tool-mediated adjustment/locking or iterative damper-response tuning.
